fusions.name: Ram Rail
fusions.desc: A headlong blow that deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles, pins it [Pinned] where it lands for 2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stamp Down
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Barbed Footing
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Dug-In Heels
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward that soaks 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
